newsitem.title: USA: Kleinwort Benson Australian rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort Benson Australian rights offer.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson Australian Income Fund Inc said on Tuesday that it would extend a transferable rights offering to shareholders of record as of September 27, or as soon as its U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing takes effect.
Under the terms of the offer, stockholders receive one transferable right for each four shares owned, the fund said.

Each right entitles the holder to subscribe for one new share at a price five percent less than the fund's average closing price on the New York Stock Exchange on the four business days following the expiration date, the company said.
The offering period will commence on September 27 and end on the expiration date of October 21.
